newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki powers ahead on strong forestries, Nokia.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki powers ahead on strong forestries, Nokia.

text.p: The bourse again approached records on Wednesday with bulls back in forestries and the broad bourse led by dollar strength and Nokia gains, brokers said.

The HEX general index rose 0.83 percent to 2,923.10, just under its 2,931.44 life-high, and the derivatives and portfolio benchmark FOX index rose 0.82 percent to 1,025.69, also approaching its 1,034.65 record set earlier this year.
"I believe the rally in forestries could continue tomorrow," one broker said, adding that UPM-Kymmene's 1996 report and comments on Tuesday boosted interest in the sector.
UPM was up 4.60 at 113.50 markka -- its highest close ever.
Bourse engine Nokia closed up 5.40 at 313.00 markka and mobile phone maker Benefon extended gains on its GSM type approval, closing up 4.10 at 116.00 markka.
Food group HK Ruokatalo HKRAVa.HE rose 3.50 to 145.50 markka after in line earnings, and Kekkila was up one at 25.00 markka after a better-than-expected result.

Despite strong sentiment, investors were still hesistant with Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan due to repeat his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony later, and overall volume was modest. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
